observations.why: Declarative adoption statement asserts a decision as settled, drawing on position authority and control of the facts themselves.
Quantitative performance comparison marshals technical knowledge as evidence to justify the adoption decision.
Commissive declaration of a timeline asserts authority to commit the organization to a migration schedule.
Bulleted decision-summary controls the framing of what was decided, supplying the facts as organized record.
Restates the performance metric as a recorded decision point, controlling the factual record of the rationale.
Records the timeline commitment as a decision artifact, controlling the factual record of when action will occur.

mints.title: adoption and timeline declared as already-decided
